caption: The glass door of a supermarket freezer is closed after being held open, and the inside of the glass fogs over, then slowly clears as the cold air circulates.

sa.check: A supermarket freezer with a glass door.
The inside of the glass fogs over.
The fog is on the inner face of the door.
The order is closed, fogged, cleared.

pc.expect: The fog forms after the door shuts and then only clears; once clear it stays clear with the door shut.
pc.fail: The fog forms before the door has closed; or the fog clears and forms again with the door shut; or the fog thickens after it has begun to clear; or the glass is fogged while the door stands open.

pc.expect: The clearing spreads from one part of the glass, such as its edges or a vent, with a visible edge.
pc.fail: The whole pane goes from fogged to clear at a stroke with no edge at all; or the fog lifts off the glass as a sheet; or the clearing starts and then reverses; or the fog clears while the door is being opened again.

pc.expect: The haze lies on the inner face and the outer face stays clear.
pc.fail: The fog forms on the outer face; or both faces fog equally; or the door's frame changes colour rather than the glass; or the goods behind the glass change colour as it fogs.

pc.expect: Drops that gather in the fog run downward on the inner face.
pc.fail: A drop runs up the glass; or a drop leaves the glass and rises; or water gathers along the glass's top edge and stays.

pc.expect: One door on its hinge; the goods behind the glass are the same before and after the fogging.
pc.fail: Packets behind the glass appear or vanish while it is fogged; or a second door appears; or the door passes through the cabinet's frame; or the door vanishes.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The cabinet's frame, its labels and the aisle stay the same.
pc.fail: The frame changes colour; or the labels change; or the aisle behind changes between frames.
